d:
a colossal automaton species resembling a stone golem with a deep charcoal gray body and a pale cream-colored face. It has a broad, square-shaped head with a single yellow glowing eye-slit and thick, blocky arms with three silver metallic claws on each hand. A heavy, columnar lower body supports a thick, stone-like torso with a singular, large red circular gem embedded in the chest. It has no tail and no wings.
BODY COLOR: deep charcoal gray
